title: PNP: Over 200 arrested protesters completed inquest amid Asean Summit

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Philippine National Police (PNP) said that more than 200 individuals arrested during protests completed their inquest proceedings on Monday, amid the Philippines’ hosting of the 49th Asean Summit. Protesters arrested in Muntinlupa and Ermita on Nov. 15 have already undergone inquest proceedings, while rallyists arrested at Liwasang Bonifacio on Nov. 16
